meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 PR 和 Issue 评论变为聊天讨论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发聊天应用并想让团队在会话中讨论代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn GitHub PR and issue discussions into chat conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app and want to sync GitHub discussions.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 可通过 GitHub 机器人账号接入评论线程。当有人在 PR 或 Issue 评论中 @ 机器人时，Claude 会回复；首次 @ 后它会订阅该线程，并自动回复后续每条评论。
howto.when: 当用户在 GitHub 的 PR 或 Issue 评论中 @ 机器人账号时触发；该线程的后续评论也会自动触发。

say.text: @机器人 请总结这个 PR 的改动。
say.note: 机器人会读取该 PR 评论线程并回复总结。

say.text: @机器人 这个 issue 的根因是什么？
say.note: 机器人会基于线程上下文给出分析。

say.text: @机器人 请检查这段代码的规范性问题。
say.note: 机器人会评论回复检查结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can join GitHub via a bot account and participate in PR and issue comment threads. When @-mentioned, Claude replies; after the first mention, it subscribes to the thread and automatically responds to all follow-up comments.
howto.when_en: Triggers when someone @-mentions the bot in a PR or issue comment. Requires webhooks for issue comments and PR review comments. After the first mention, the thread is subscribed, so follow-up comments also trigger replies.

say_en.text: @bot Please summarize the changes in this PR.
say_en.note: The bot reads the PR comment thread and replies with a summary.

say_en.text: @bot What's the root cause of this issue?
say_en.note: The bot analyzes based on the thread context.

say_en.text: @bot Please check this code for style issues.
say_en.note: The bot replies with review results in the comments.
